evidence.title: BenthicDINO: Physics-Informed Self-Distillation for View-Invariant Side-Scan Sonar Representations

summary: Researchers unveiled BenthicDINO, a novel framework that combines physics‑based constraints with self‑distillation to produce sonar image embeddings that remain consistent across differing viewing angles. The approach promises more reliable underwater mapping and object detection by improving the robustness of side‑scan sonar representations.
title: BenthicDINO Introduces Physics‑Informed Self‑Distillation for View‑Invariant Side‑Scan Sonar Representations
